issues.detail: Only supporting information is locally available; article-wide route coverage remains unverified.
issues.subject: article

issues.detail: Printed name has a heptadec chain and shifted locants; the drawn structure has an octadec chain. The graph follows the numbered drawing, consistent with neutral C33H54O6Si.
HRMS prints C33H58NO6SiNa while assigning [M+NH4]+ at 592.4033. Extra Na in that literal formula is incompatible with the stated mass; formula and adduct checks are separated.
Lactol and THP anomers and newly formed alcohol configurations are unspecified in source drawings; no absolute configuration is invented.
issues.subject: S2/15/17/18/19/S6/20

issues.detail: 12 is Z:E 9:1. S8 and final 5 contain a minor C9 epimer with no fraction given. Isolated material yields are not assigned to individual pure stereoisomers.
issues.subject: 12/S8/5

issues.detail: 97.124% ee is calculated from source HPLC peak areas 98.562 and 1.438, not an explicitly printed ee value; it is not propagated as product enantiopurity.
issues.subject: S4

issues.detail: Crude intermediate preparations report no percentage yield. Masses are not converted into invented isolated yields.
